repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period with a threshold of 30 ticks, causing the action to fire at 29 seconds (30 ticks) instead of the required 30 seconds (300 ticks). The IR requires a 30-second sustained window, which corresponds to 300 ticks on a 100 ms grid. The candidate's threshold of 30 is off by a factor of 10.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the wrapper period from 1000 ms to 100 ms to align with the sustain duration calculation. Updated the threshold from 30 to 301 (30 seconds / 100 ms + 1) to ensure the condition is sustained for the full 30 seconds before triggering the switch.
